meta.title: Secondary School
meta.description: Kreativa Global Secondary School (Grade 7–9): Cambridge Lower Secondary and IGCSE preparation, grounded in faith and character.

hero.title: Welcome to Kreativa Global Secondary School
hero.subtitle: Grounded in faith, guided by knowledge — nurturing global-minded leaders with integrity and compassion.

pathway.title: Curriculum Pathway
pathway.note: Numbers in brackets are Cambridge syllabus codes.

items.title: Faith & Leadership Expedition
items.body: Outdoor, reflective experiences that build faith, resilience, and teamwork.

items.title: Global Exchange & Community Service
items.body: Cultural exchange and service projects that build empathy, teamwork, and global awareness.

items.title: Personal Mastery Track
items.body: A journey of self-discovery and growth where student learn to understand themselves, build confidence and develop the mindset to lead, create and thrive in life.

items.title: Kreativa Capstone Exhibition & Innovation Symposium
items.body: Students research, design, and present real-world solutions — integrating science, creativity, and leadership.

closing.text: Discover more about Kreativa Global Secondary School — where faith meets excellence and every learner is prepared to lead with impact.
